Name: Claire the Part-Timer - SVE Standalone NPC
Author: DolphinIsNotaFish
Description:
Claire is an SVE marriage candidate who buses in from the countryside every day to work at JojaMart. She is a quiet young woman who is chasing a dream she's too embarrassed to say out loud...

[size=6][b]L[/b][/size][size=5][b]atest Update[/b][/size]
Added several mod supports for:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21012][i]Darkroom Portrait Shop[/i][/url]: have Haley take Claire's portrait so you can get it without needing to marry her.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40083][i]Have More Kids and Adopt Leo[/i][/url]: Claire is not more involved in Leo's adoption scene.[/*]
[/list][b][color=#dd7e6b][size=6]D[/size][size=5]ifferences[/size][/color][/b]
This mod has several differences from the original SVE version:
[spoiler][list]
[*]Platonic and Romantic routes: whether you want to stay as friends or pursue romance with her, you can reach 10 hearts either way.[/*]
[*]Restructured Heart events: her heart events have been restructured and rewritten so you can witness her full arc without marriage. Her spouse event at 14 heart focuses more on her domestic life.[/*]
[*]Change of schedule: once Claire has completed her arc, she will actually leave her job as a part-timer.[/*]
[*]Part-time replacements: there are two additional part-timer characters who would fill the gap Claire left.[/*]
[*]New movie: Adds a brand new movie to play at the theater after Claire's arc is finished.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[b][color=#ffe599][size=6]M[/size][/color][size=5][color=#ffe599]ods Support[/color][/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367][i]Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn[/i][/url]: automatically adjusts to match its recolor.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787][i]East Scarp[/i][/url]: Juliet will be involved in several events with it installed.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8000][i]Central Station[/i][/url]: Claire's house will be visitable after a certain event.[/*]
[/list][color=#b6d7a8][b][size=6]I[/size][size=5]nstallation[/size][/b][/color]
[list]
[*]Make sure you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][i]Content Patcher[/i][/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27100][i]BETAS[/i][/url] installed.[/*]
[*]Download [b][i]Claire the Part-Timer[/i][/b].[/*]
[*]Extract the downloaded file into the game's [font=Lucida Sans Unicode]Mods[/font] folder.[/*]
[/list]To uninstall, simply delete [font=Lucida Sans Unicode][CP] Claire the Part-Timer[/font] from your Mods folder.

[b][color=#a2c4c9][size=6]K[/size][size=5]nown Issues[/size][/color][/b]
When installed on an existing save file, a custom NPC will not have a schedule on the first day. As a result, the shop where Claire works will be left unattended. This issue should resolve from the second day onward.

[b][color=#a2c4c9][size=6]C[/size][size=5]ompatibility[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*]Not compatible with [i][b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b][/i], for obvious reasons.[/*]
[*]No other known compatibility issues.[/*]
[/list][b][color=#9fc5e8][size=6]T[/size][size=5]ranslations[/size][/color][/b]
This mod uses i18n. If you want to make a translation for it, feel free to either give it to me (so I could incorporate it into the mod) or upload them yourself (do tell me so I can link to them!).[/b]
[spoiler][b]Built-in[/b]
[list]
[*][b]American English[/b] 1.2.0[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
